headline: WuXi AppTec Raises Full-Year Guidance After 62% Net Profit Surge
summary: WuXi AppTec raised its 2026 revenue guidance after reporting a 62.4% net profit surge to 19.16 billion yuan for the nine months ended September 30, driven by drug development demand.
why: WuXi AppTec is a global pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical, and medical device contract research and manufacturing organization based in China.

impacts.name: WuXi AppTec
impacts.why: Strong earnings growth and increased outlook signal robust revenue generation and operational momentum.

why_moved: Upward revisions to full-year corporate revenue guidance consistently bolster market sentiment toward underlying equities.
